svg.title: Voice MCP Server
svg.desc: Clients call the MCP API and receive a job view. New jobs are committed to PostgreSQL. One active worker claims jobs, runs inference, publishes files, and records outcomes. In split mode an optional WakeController observes the same jobs and worker registry, starts the configured Docker or ECS target, and drains the worker when idle.

svg.text: Run together or split the API and worker. In split mode, the API
serves requests while the GPU is off.
Scale API replicas separately. On AWS, the capacity provider
MCP requests, durable jobs, local inference, and optional GPU control.
